title: Rental Reimbursement Coverage Eligibility: Adding the Coverage and Changing Packages
content:
**Eligibility rule.** Rental Reimbursement Coverage is added only to a vehicle whose physical damage coverage is inspection pending or active. It is added effective the date requested, never earlier, and starts on its effective date; a package change takes effect on the date requested. Rental is never sold without physical damage coverage.

## 1. The physical damage coverage the test reads

The coverage tested is the vehicle's own physical damage coverage — the one the rental coverage is attached to. Its status is taken from the company's records before the addition is made; a customer's statement about that coverage does not replace the record.

| Status of that physical damage coverage | Rental Reimbursement Coverage may be added |
|---|---|
| Inspection pending | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Any other status | No |
| No physical damage coverage on the vehicle | No — rental is never sold without physical damage coverage |

## 2. Dates

| Event | Takes effect |
|---|---|
| Rental coverage added | On the date requested, never earlier |
| Coverage start | On its effective date; a coverage added for a later date stands as scheduled until that date and becomes active when the effective date is reached |
| Package change mid-term | On the date requested |

The packages a named insured may move between are the six Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement packages, $20/$600 through $60/$1,800.

## 3. Cases (hypothetical)

- A vehicle's physical damage coverage stands as inspection pending. Rental coverage may be added to it.
- A vehicle's physical damage coverage has expired. Rental coverage is not added to it.
- A named insured requests the addition for a hypothetical date Q. The coverage takes effect on Q, not on any earlier date; if Q is still ahead, the coverage stands as scheduled until Q.
- A named insured requests, for a hypothetical date Q, a change from the $25/$750 package to the $40/$1,200 package. The change takes effect on Q.
